scope: Regular state UI eligibility, weekly-benefit formula, waiting week, duration, partial-earnings disregard and work search. Min/max WBA live in data/research/laws/local-starting-law/unemployment-weekly-bounds.json and are not repeated.
sourceNotes: Primary: DOL ETA 'Significant Provisions of State UI Laws, effective July 2026' (qualifying earnings, WBA computation, earnings disregarded, max benefit, weeks payable).

The requested 'Comparison of State UI Laws 2025' URL returns 404 on oui.doleta.gov (checked 2026-10-12); the DOL state-laws page links only the 2023 Comparison, used for waiting week (Table 3-7), duration rules (Table 3-12) and work search (Table 5-14).
Dollar qualifying amounts tagged estimate were computed from 2026 minimum WBA, minimum wage or state average wage, or carried from the 2023 Comparison.

Unemployment-rate-indexed durations: value2026 uses each state's rule with approximate 2026 state unemployment rates (all indexed states were below their lowest trigger), so value2026 is the bottom step.

fieldKey.weeklyBenefitFormula.fraction: Multiplier applied to the base named in fractionAppliesTo (e.g. 1/26 of HQW = 0.038462; 1/26 of the average of 2 HQs = 1/52 of their sum = 0.019231; AWW kinds give the percent of the average weekly wage).
